normalProducer.sourceWrite: normal-generated-outputs-only; tracked source and complete installed dependency census immutable

workspaceInventory.recordEncoding: SHA256 of deterministic sorted depth-first NDJSON records, UTF-8, final newline per record
workspaceInventory.entryBoundDecision: Explicit source proposal from prior100000 entry cap to1000000; requires Root acceptance before publication/job. No memory/CPU/heap/time/network/disk floor relaxation.

hostedUnprivilegedNamespaceProof.operation: Read-only own namespace descriptor/fstat/readlink plus exact source-bound reserved inode and child-allocation-range proof; descriptor closes in finally. No PID1 namespace readlink or new subprocess/privilege.
hostedUnprivilegedNamespaceProof.unknownKernel: Reject missing-root-ceiling admission; do not reuse constant across unreviewed source versions.
